=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2063-2210 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The release_gate_runner_wait skip counts a job as "runner-wait only" when its first failing step (`failing_step`) is a watch step and the job log has a `RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=(cancel_requested|stop_failed)` marker. It never checks the job's other failed steps. It also accepts `stop_failed`, and it compares failed job IDs rather than failed steps.
  WHY: A real failure in a later `if: always()` step of the same job (e.g. the soft-error analyser at test-and-mark-stable.yml:4098-4100, the cleanup steps, or the new cancel step's gh reads) still leads to `skip reason=release_gate_runner_wait` and exit 0, so the failure is never filed. The same happens when the gate-stop API call failed and the gate was not cancelled. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says NIT (narrow window); minimax, openai and glm say MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:207-309 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait` (alt_rw_list at 207-210, queued-candidate loop at 236-260, alt_rw_verdict at 282-293, 298-309) never lists `waiting`/`pending` runs. It treats every `queued` candidate as a runner wait without reading its jobs, and reads jobs only for in_progress runs.
  WHY: A run held by a concurrency group (implement.yml `cancel-in-progress: false`) gets classified as `never_assigned`/`runner_wait`. With DISPATCH_WATCH_STOP_RELEASE_GATE=true the gate cancels itself, the run ends as "no attempt used" and heal intake skips it, which hides the real blocker and violates G3. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this and could not build a concrete false-runner_wait path.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4082-4647 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Cancel dispatched child runs when the gate is cancelled" steps at lines 4082 and 4647 run only on `if: cancelled()`. When `dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate` fails (`detail=cancel_failed` or `detail=still_running` after DISPATCH_WATCH_STOP_WAIT_SECS=240), the run ends as `failure`. It can also end as `failure` when the watch step's `exit 1` races ahead of the cancel.
  WHY: The cleanup is then skipped and the dispatched children (validation-refresh, update_workflows, memory-maintenance, internal-validate) keep holding runners, which defeats G3. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputed this: they say DISPATCH_WATCH_CANCEL_ON_TIMEOUT and the always() cleanups already cancel those children.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:1026-1035 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `rw_poll_kind` held/queued tracking reads E2E_REVIEW_LAST_JOBS_JSON, which they say was filled on the previous poll tick, so the classification lags one poll behind.
  WHY: A late move from held to queued-no-runner just before the Phase 4 budget closes is recorded as held, so the gate fails and spends a release attempt. Severity disagreement: minimax says NIT and gemini gives none. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disproved this: `e2e_review_note_run_started` clears the value and refills it from the same poll.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:487-491,1026-1035 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: For a valid but empty jobs array, the `rw_poll_kind` jq returns `" "` instead of `none`, so the RUN_STATUS `queued` fallback never fires and neither REVIEW_RUNNER_WAIT_QUEUED_SEEN nor _HELD_SEEN is set.
  WHY: The never_assigned branch (487-491) needs QUEUED_SEEN=1, so the run ends as `status=timeout` and the gate fails (spending an attempt) instead of stopping as runner_wait. This does not match the watcher's empty-jobs never_assigned rule. It fails closed, so both reviewers rate it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3 — "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, job `workflow-log-analysis-test` (dispatch step "Dispatch & snapshot — workflow-log-analysis", id dispatch_log_analysis, lines 3654-3709)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The `if: cancelled()` cancel step exists only in orphan-workflows-test (line 4082) and validate-standalone-test (line 4647). The workflow-log-analysis child is dispatched with `--snapshot-only` (it returns at scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh line 548) and is not in GATE_CHILD_RUN_IDS. No step reads `steps.dispatch_log_analysis.outputs.dispatched_run_id` to cancel it. tests/test_dispatch_and_watch_cancel_on_timeout.py::test_gate_workflow_wires_the_alt_model_check_and_child_cancels pins the count at exactly 2. The child keeps holding a runner after the gate cancels itself.
- requirement: G4 — "The workflow-failure-heal intake does not file an issue for a gate run whose only failed steps ended as runner_wait."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, failed-job selection and the runner-wait skip check
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: MAX_FAILED_JOBS defaults to 3 at line 375. Evidence selection is limited at lines 2033-2041, and the skip requires the matched count to be <= MAX_FAILED_JOBS at lines 2192-2203. A gate run with more than three failed jobs that are all runner-wait jobs does not take the skip path and gets filed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:lines 2063-2073 (the `case "${failing_step}" in ... "Dispatch & watch — "* | ... | "Wait for clarify→plan→implement (alt-model)"` match combined with `grep -qE '^[^ ]+ RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=(cancel_requested|stop_failed) ' "${RAW_LOG}"`); skip decision at lines 2181-2208 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A job counts as runner-wait only when its first failed step is a watch step and the marker appears anywhere in the log. The check never confirms that no other step in the job failed, such as later `if: always()` steps like "Soft-error analyser (memory_maintenance)" (test-and-mark-stable.yml:4098-4099) or the cleanup steps.
  WHY: The intake skips with reason=release_gate_runner_wait and exits 0, so a separate real failure is never filed. The window is narrow (stop_failed, or the cancel did not land within 240s). Hardening suggestion (risk 1, 4-6 lines): add `run_id:job_id` only when every failed/timed_out step has the same name as `failing_step`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G3 — "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, job `workflow-log-analysis-test` (dispatch step "Dispatch & snapshot — workflow-log-analysis" at line 3654, id dispatch_log_analysis)
  Evidence of absence: The `--snapshot-only` dispatch returns after registration (line 548). Cancel steps exist only at line 4082 and line 4647, and the test pins the count at 2. No cancel step for `steps.dispatch_log_analysis.outputs.dispatched_run_id`.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:alt_rw_verdict logic at lines 282-293 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: dispatch_watch_alt_model_runner_wait does not identify jobs held in "waiting"/"pending" (environment or concurrency limits).
  WHY: Concurrency-held jobs are misclassified as "never_assigned" runner waits, so the gate is cancelled when it should have waited or failed.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:polling logic at lines 1026-1035 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Runner-wait tracking relies on E2E_REVIEW_LAST_JOBS_JSON, which is updated one poll tick behind, so the held/queued classification is stale.
  WHY: A held→queued move just before the Phase 4 budget closes can be misclassified, and the gate may not stop when a runner wait is the true blocker.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:intake logic at lines 2066-2070 and 2188-2203 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner-wait skip checks only that the first failing step is a watch step and that the marker is present, not that all failing steps were runner waits.
  WHY: A real failure in an `if: always()` cleanup step in the same job is hidden by the skip.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Cleanup steps at lines 4082 and 4647 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The child-cancel steps run only on `if: cancelled()`.
  WHY: If dispatch_watch_stop_release_gate fails (`detail=cancel_failed`/`detail=still_running`), the watch step ends as failure and not cancelled, so cleanup is skipped and orphaned children keep holding runners, which defeats G3.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G3 — "The gate then stops early, cancels the child runs it started, and the cycle ends with a conclusion the release scripts read as 'no attempt used'."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, job workflow-log-analysis-test
  Evidence of absence: Cleanup steps exist only in orphan-workflows-test and validate-standalone-test. The workflow-log-analysis child (dispatched at line 3654) is not in `GATE_CHILD_RUN_IDS`, so it stays orphaned.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  PROBLEM: The check never lists `pending`/`waiting` runs and treats every `queued` candidate as a runner wait without reading its jobs. Concurrency-held runs (implement.yml `cancel-in-progress: false`) are dropped from the check or cannot be ruled out.
  WHY: A held run next to a queued-no-runner sibling produces `ALT_MODEL_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=runner_wait`, then `RELEASE_GATE_RUNNER_WAIT outcome=cancel_requested`, then a skipped heal intake. The gate ends cancelled and the real blocker is hidden (violates G3).

  WHY: The intake exits 0 with `skip reason=release_gate_runner_wait` and hides the real downstream failure.
